target: forge.sh pr-create (github) — an open PR for the head is printed and gh pr create is not invoked
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://github.com/o/r.git
fx_gh pr_list 0 'https://github.com/o/r/pull/4'
fx_gh pr_create 0 'https://github.com/o/r/pull/99'
fx_run pr-create --head feat --base main --title T --body-file body.md; fx_show r
echo "creates=$(fx_count gh pr create)"; echo "lists=$(fx_count gh pr list)"; echo "requests=$(fx_nreq)"
fx_done
